steps.label: Collection
steps.text: The sap flows from the tree into buckets. Note the different particles: blue sap, alongside trace amounts of green PFAS and gray lead from older equipment.

steps.label: Distillation
steps.text: The raw, watery sap is boiled down to a fraction of its volume, concentrating into a thick, amber syrup in a classic flask.

steps.label: Packaging
steps.text: The sealed flasks are carefully packed into wooden crates, preparing them for the journey ahead.

steps.label: Shipping
steps.text: Finally, the heavy crates are loaded onto trucks to be distributed safely across the country.
